name: Stream Monsters
description: Portrait-first Jackpot Arena with an animated Living Egg Shelf, creator-selected gift eggs, recurring free-egg adoption, sealed A/B/C PvP, balanced elemental roles, 72 bundled Furry forms, permanent progression, and cinematic OBS overlays.
author: Pup Cid

descriptions.en: Portrait-first Jackpot Arena with an animated Living Egg Shelf, creator-selected gift eggs, recurring free-egg adoption, sealed A/B/C PvP, balanced elemental roles, 72 bundled Furry forms, permanent progression, and cinematic OBS overlays.
descriptions.de: Portrait-first Jackpot-Arena mit animiertem Living Egg Shelf, vom Creator gewählten Gift-Eiern, wiederkehrender Gratis-Ei-Adoption, verdecktem A/B/C-PvP, balancierten Elementrollen, 72 gebündelten Furry-Formen und permanentem Fortschritt.
descriptions.es: Jackpot Arena vertical con Living Egg Shelf animado, huevos por regalos elegidos por el creador, adopción periódica de huevos gratis, PvP A/B/C sellado, roles elementales equilibrados, 72 formas Furry y progreso permanente.
descriptions.fr: Jackpot Arena portrait avec Living Egg Shelf animé, œufs issus des cadeaux choisis par le Creator, adoption récurrente d'œufs gratuits, PvP A/B/C scellé, rôles élémentaires équilibrés, 72 formes Furry et progression permanente.
